title: Governed initiative timebox and staggered delivery protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large company-level initiatives frequently slip because teams treat the initiative as a single monolith instead of a sequence of dependent deliverables. That leads to missed OKR milestones, unclear handoffs between infra, runtime, and product, and ad-hoc scope changes.

Proposal: Introduce a governed timebox and staggered delivery protocol for company-level OKR initiatives. Each initiative will be decomposed into 3-5 discrete timeboxed waves (Discovery, Core Delivery, Scale/Beta, General Availability, Follow-up). Waves have explicit entry/exit gates, acceptance criteria, and cross-team owners. A lean governance cadence (weekly gating sync + lightweight triage board) will enforce dependencies, surface blockers, and enable predictable roadmap commitments.

Goals: Make cross-functional commitments explicit, reduce end-to-end slippage by 40% for company-level initiatives, improve predictability of quarterly roadmap commitments, and create a clear upgrade/rollout path for customers and Dedicated/Private deployments.

Scope: Company-level initiatives that touch three or more teams (Engineering, Product, Design, Research, Security, Customer Success). Not intended for small feature work or single-team maintenance tasks.

Out of scope: Tactical sprint-level planning, individual PRD content, implementation minutiae. Those continue to live in team-level tickets and repos.
acceptance_criteria: A documented wave template exists in Confluence and is linked from the initiative epic.
Each company-level initiative in the next two quarters has been decomposed into waves with owners and dates.
Gating rubric (pass/soft-pass/fail) is defined and applied at least once for two pilot initiatives.
Dashboard shows wave-level progress and dependency graph for all active company initiatives.
Triaging cadence established and adopted by leads (at least 3 teams represented) for pilot initiatives.
success_metrics: Baseline initiative slippage reduced by 40% vs prior quarter
Percentage of company-level initiatives with wave decomposition >= 90%
Mean time to unblock critical dependency reduced by 30%
Stakeholder satisfaction (survey) >= 4/5 for the pilot initiatives
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Added governance overhead could slow teams. Mitigation: Keep gating lightweight (15m), require evidence not documents.
Risk: Incomplete decomposition leads to missed dependencies. Mitigation: Mandatory dependency mapping as part of wave sign-off.
Risk: Perceived loss of autonomy. Mitigation: Frame as roadmap hygiene with opt-in pilots and measurable ROI.
Risk: Tooling gaps for visualization. Mitigation: Prototype a view in Console and mirror summaries to Confluence.
